note: Manifest of the Code on the Go build assets to mirror and serve offline (K2GO-437). Single source of truth: mirror_code_assets.py reads it to know what to download, and renders the browse page from the title and description of each entry. 'path' is the file location under both the source base and the local serve base; each file also has a sibling '<path>.md5' used for integrity and change detection. The source base is a role variable (code_assets_source_base), so when the assets move from appdevforall.org/dev-assets to Cloudflare R2 only that default changes, not this file. This serves the RELEASE set (what the shipped Code on the Go consumes); the debug set exists in dev-assets for developer builds and is intentionally not mirrored. Keep this list in step with Code on the Go's app/build.gradle.kts releaseAssets.
